candidates.name: strict_two_step_growth
candidates.motivation: The odd branch is expanding. The smallest dual of the proved odd-even descent is strict two-step growth on the complementary cylinder.
candidates.relevant_domain: D_OO = {odd x : T(x) odd and T^2(x) defined}
candidates.expected_yield: exact two-step growth law, or a threshold/equality obstruction
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: the first frozen D_OO seed with T^2(x) <= x
candidates.failure_mechanism: Strict growth fails at 1->1->1: T^2(1)=1 is not > 1. Fixed point or threshold.

candidates.name: thresholded_two_step_growth
candidates.exact_statement: For n in D_OO with n >= 3, T^2(n) > n. The threshold 3 is the exact comparison (n+1)^2 <= n^3, not a fitted constant.
candidates.motivation: For n>=3, isqrt(n^3) >= n+1. If T(n) is odd then T is nondecreasing on that image, so two odd steps grow. Dual of T^2 < n on D_OE.
candidates.expected_yield: exact complementary inequality with a derived threshold
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: the first frozen D_OO seed n>=3 with T^2(n) <= n

candidates.name: odd_cylinder_preservation
candidates.exact_statement: x in D_OO implies T^2(x) is odd
candidates.motivation: Parity is the floor-power branch bit. Two successive odd steps might remain in the odd cylinder. Modulus 2 is the branch mechanism, not a residue sweep.
candidates.relevant_domain: D_OO = {odd x : T(x) odd and T^2(x) defined}
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: the first frozen D_OO seed whose T^2 is even
candidates.failure_mechanism: Odd-cylinder leaks at 5->11->36: T^2(5)=36 is even, so T^2 leaves D_OO.

anti_tautology_checks.reason: T^2(n)>n on D_OO, n>=3 uses the second-step odd parity to select the expanding formula, then the comparison (n+1)^2 <= n^3. It is not T=floor(n^(3/2)) written twice. T(n)>n for odd n>=3 holds on D_OE as well, but T^2>n does not: the even second step contracts.

proposals.trigger: exact T^2 > n on D_OO for n>=3
proposals.mathematical_target: Package the dual odd-odd two-step growth lemma. Do not claim divergence.
proposals.mechanism: Keep k=2. Do not generalize odd_even_two_step_decrease automatically.
proposals.expected_yield: Lean-certified local branch law T^2(n)>n on D_OO, n>=3
proposals.falsifier: An n>=3 in D_OO with T^2(n)<=n.
proposals.novelty_risk_reason: the inequality is the exact dual of the proved odd-even descent

proposals.trigger: odd-odd growth is local; basin of 1 remains open
proposals.mathematical_target: Characterize predecessors of 1 under floor-power. Not a halt attack.
proposals.mechanism: Do not use T^2>n as a Lyapunov function.
proposals.expected_yield: regular-preimage lemma or a splitting pair for reachability of 1
proposals.falsifier: Two predecessor states indistinguishable by the proposed quotient.
proposals.novelty_risk_reason: Phase-9 backup; image/basin is independent of the local growth law

proposals.trigger: odd-even and odd-odd two-step lemmas are both local
proposals.mathematical_target: Ask whether mixed-parity itineraries have an exact k=2 law without raising depth.
proposals.mechanism: If k>2 is required, PARK. Do not manufacture a survivor by depth.
proposals.expected_yield: a mixed-parity identity at depth 2, or a stop at richer structure
proposals.falsifier: A mixed-parity pair on which every k=2 size law fails.
proposals.novelty_risk_reason: cylinder leakage 5->11->36 already shows T^2 is not odd-invariant
